## Contribution checklist

- [ ] I am covered by the current Conveyal CLA.
- [ ] Any third-party material is identified with its license and source.
- [ ] If an employer or organization owns this work, I have its authorization.

The automated CLA check validates every human commit author. To sign, see the
[central CLA instructions](https://github.com/conveyal/CLA-Ledger/blob/main/CLA.md).
